rule.name: SpringStartupCleanup
rule.message: Release what this startup method already started when this call fails: put the call in a try and shut the event loops, executors or servers down in its catch before rethrowing, or in a finally. Spring does not call @PreDestroy on a bean whose startup failed, so the started threads keep the JVM running and the application hangs instead of exiting.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $loops := function($e) { exists($e[self::ConstructorCall or self::MethodCall[*[1][self::TypeExpression]]] [pmd-java:typeIs('io.netty.util.concurrent.EventExecutorGroup') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Timer')]) }, $pool := function($e) { exists($e[self::ConstructorCall or self::MethodCall[*[1][self::TypeExpression]]] [pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService')]) }, $cleanup := 'shutdown|close|stop|terminate|dispose|destroy|release|cancel|clean|abort' return //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[ pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration')]] /ClassBody/(ConstructorDeclaration | MethodDeclaration[ ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.annotation.PostConstruct')] or (@Name = 'afterPropertiesSet' and @Arity = 0 and ../..[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean')]) or (@Name = 'run' and ../..[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.ApplicationRunner') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.CommandLineRunner')]) or (@Name = 'start' and @Arity = 0 and ../..[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.Lifecycle')]) or (@Arity = 0 and @Name = //Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')] /AnnotationMemberList/MemberValuePair[@Name = 'initMethod']//StringLiteral/@ConstValue)]) //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('bind', 'connect', 'start')] [*[1][not(self::ArgumentList or self::TypeExpression or self::SuperExpression or self::ThisExpression)] [not(pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread.Builder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.regex.Matcher') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.util.StopWatch'))]] [let $call := ., $method := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration][1], $body := $method/.., $fields := $body/FieldDeclaration[not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'static')], $before := $method//*[. << $call], $owned := ($fields/VariableDeclarator/*[2], $body/ConstructorDeclaration//*, $before), $poolNames := ($fields/VariableDeclarator[*[2][$pool(.)]]/VariableId/@Name, $method//VariableDeclarator[*[2][$pool(.)]]/VariableId/@Name), $started := exists($owned[$loops(.)]) or exists($before[self::ConstructorCall][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]) or exists($before[self::MethodCall][@MethodName = 'start'][*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread')]]) or exists($before[self::MethodCall] [@MethodName = ('execute', 'submit', 'schedule', 'scheduleAtFixedRate', 'scheduleWithFixedDelay', 'invokeAll')] [*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $poolNames]]), $guarded := exists($call/ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement]/parent::TryStatement [(CatchClause | FinallyClause)//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $cleanup, 'i')] or CatchClause[not(.//ThrowStatement)]]) return
